title: Too Little, Too Late
syncedLyrics:
[00:00.07] The whole town is talking 'bout how you've fallen in love
[00:09.42] I read in the papers, he's someone that girls dream about
[00:18.44] Some kind of ruler on top of a kingdom
[00:23.66] I'm just a jester, I'll never be him
[00:27.70] Last night, you called to me
[00:32.72] It almost killed me
[00:37.64] To hear you scream my name
[00:43.81] Your smile still kills the same
[00:47.85] I almost turned around
[00:52.53] You chased me to the ground
[00:57.08] You asked me how I've been, but how do I begin
[01:06.01] To tell you I should've chased you 'cross every single state
[01:15.04] I lay down my sword for fate
[01:19.53] 'Cause it's too little way too late
[01:28.73] I didn't need the reminder of things I've done wrong
[01:37.41] Of promises broken, fragility hidden in song
[01:45.75] Guess that we're soulmates in different lifetimes
[01:50.28] What if you leave him, throw me a lifeline
[01:54.81] I know that you're happy
[01:59.49] But it just killed me
[02:03.68] To hear you scream my name
[02:08.95] A clear fucking X-ray of if I'd stuck around
[02:18.05] I swear to God, I almost drowned
[02:22.40] You asked me how I've been, but how could I begin
[02:31.44] To tell you I should've chased you
[02:36.42] I should be who you're engaged to
[02:40.89] Lost my fight with fate
[02:44.95] A tug-of-war of leave and stay
[02:49.33] I give in, I abdicate
[02:53.62] I lay my sword down anyway
[02:57.85] I'll see you at Heaven's gate
[03:01.99] 'Cause it's too little, way too late
[03:20.05] I'll toast outside your wedding day
[03:36.38] Whisper vows, I'll never say to you
[03:44.45] 'Cause it's too little, all too late
